description: [forged] Offline validator for a Mexican RFC (Registro Federal de Contribuyentes). Checks the format for persona física (4 letters + 6-digit date + 3-char homoclave) or persona moral (3 letters + 6-digit date + 3-char homoclave), verifies the embedded date is a real calendar date, and returns the parsed birth/incorporation date. Pure string/date logic, no network calls. (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))
name: rfc_validate
